- Drums: Federico Gucciardo
- Bass: Phil Gonnand
- Saxophone: Dima Faustov
- Guitar: Jens Ambrosch
- Guitar: Dr. Károly Zsolnai-Fehér

If you wish to play a cover, the guitar tab is available here for free: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/2x2v6etorp2psnieg4ka6/two-minute-papers-not-perfect.gp?rlkey=kr6n0hhawzhm4xupqalsvfn66&st=kv5igisa&e=1&dl=1
